assumptions.fx_source: China Foreign Exchange Trade System central parity published 2026-08-21

warnings: Price is not performance: vCPU generations and architectures have different throughput.
General/shared RDS classes are not isolation-equivalent to exclusive ECS/EC2 instances.
Private commercial discounts are contract-specific and are not embedded in public price tables.
Object-storage retrieval latency and minimum-duration semantics must match before comparing rates.
Tax, support, credit, utilization, and commitment waste are modeled separately from list rates.
